summary.headline: Backend-focused Full-Stack Developer specializing in Python, FastAPI, AWS, and AI engineering
summary.description: Backend-focused full-stack developer with 9 years of experience building production systems end-to-end, from architecture through deployment. Strong specialization in Python, FastAPI, SQL, asynchronous APIs, React, and CI/CD, with experience across fintech, investment operations, construction, oil and gas, and financial consulting. Active AI engineering focus spanning LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, vector databases, and agentic AI.

keyDifferentiators.title: End-to-end product delivery
keyDifferentiators.description: Builds and ships production systems across backend architecture, APIs, databases, frontend applications, security, containerization, and CI/CD deployment.

keyDifferentiators.title: Fintech and financial-domain expertise
keyDifferentiators.description: Combines software engineering experience with an MSc in Banking and Finance and CFA Level I, including portfolio management, broker API integrations, financial reporting, and creditworthiness modeling.

keyDifferentiators.title: Quantified operational impact
keyDifferentiators.description: Delivered measurable improvements including 10% higher production output, 7% fewer defects, 20% faster procurement and quality workflows, and 75% faster management reporting.

keyDifferentiators.title: Emerging AI engineering capability
keyDifferentiators.description: Developing hands-on expertise in LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, RAG architectures, vector databases, and agentic AI through professional projects and certification.
